posts.title: MobileSec #1: Four ways to lose your crypto without giving up your seed phrase
posts.description: An unpatched iOS sandbox escape, an App Store wallet tracker that stole $580K, an Android RAT that asks Grok to read your SMS, and replayed webcam recordings in fake work calls.

posts.title: MobileSec #0 — A PDF that crashes iOS, exploits in Instagram ads, patched banking apps
posts.description: A PDF that crashes iOS, iPhone exploits hidden in ads, an Android trojan that swaps your banking app, and how to prove a selfie came from a real camera.

posts.title: Hashes: A Good Tool You Shouldn't Trust Blindly
posts.description: You meet hashes all day as an iOS dev — hash maps, git, checksums. MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security, yet hashes are still useful if you know what they actually prove. A short, concrete note.
